parsed.post: Discarding the last run (0.9946) as it was worse than my best (0.9874). The ASPECT_RATIO 64 increase likely hindered convergence at MATRIX_LR 0.03. Reverting to ASPECT_RATIO 48. Next: testing MATRIX_LR 0.02 with ASPECT_RATIO 48 to aim for a better balance between capacity and convergence speed.
parsed.description: Reverting ASPECT_RATIO to 48 and reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.02 to see if a lower learning rate compensates for the smaller width to improve convergence.
